name: devgram
description: Devgram is a developer-centric social media platform inspired by Instagram. It allows developers to share project screenshots and code snippets, connect with peers, and showcase their work in a clean, interactive feed. Built with Next.js, MongoDB, and a modern UI stack, Devgram is made for the dev community to share, learn, and grow together.

paragraphs: Devgram is a developer-focused social app inspired by Instagram. Developers share screenshots, videos and code snippets, follow each other, comment and message.
features: Feed of photo, video and code posts; photos and videos upload from your device (or paste a link)
Code posts with up to 5 files in 27 languages: line numbers, Copy, and Run for HTML and JavaScript in a locked-down sandbox; written in Monaco (VS Code's editor) on computers

Files from GitHub in code posts: connect your GitHub account to pick from your public repositories, or paste a link to any public file; mark the lines that matter, and the post opens on them, linked to the exact commit
DevBits: short vertical videos (up to 90 seconds) in a full-screen swipe feed, on their own tab and on profiles
Like, comment and save posts; saves are private to each user

whatItDoes.text: Devgram is a developer-focused social app inspired by Instagram. Developers share screenshots, videos and code snippets, follow each other, comment and message.

requirements.text: The code runs in an iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts" and nothing else, so it can't reach Devgram's storage, cookies or sign-in.
